en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the Sanctuary of the Madonna of Caravaggio in Montagnaga di Pinè. In the foreground is a neoclassical church with a dome and small bell tower, decorated with banners and flags as people stand and walk near the entrance. To the left, across an unpaved square, are several multi‑story buildings, one with a visible hotel sign. Trees and hills frame the religious complex, giving it an alpine village atmosphere.
